svg.title: For a countable leaf family at one dictionary key with common support S, complex charges ri and real-leaf bounds bi, assume P i |ri|biescB(S) < ∞. Sum real and imaginary charge families separately. Each sum is a real leaf bounded by P i |ri|bi; locality, gauge invariance, measurability and eligibility pass through absolute convergence. Sound and tuned transport identities pass the quote through the sum. Charges 1, i therefore reproduce both original and transported profiles with total marker price at most 2wv P i |ri|bi. An insertion tale has finitely many keys, so grouping within each key preserves support weights and gives finite singleton leaves. A tale priced Av costs at most 2wvAv,
